messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for the card border transitions and win banner. The normal 120 ms transition and single 600 ms pulse remain in place when reduced motion is off.

Type checking, all 138 unit tests, and both motion-specific browser tests passed. The full browser suite passed 75 of 76 cases; the artwork case timed out at 30 seconds, then passed when rerun with a temporary 90-second limit. The project-wide formatting check reported existing issues in 13 unrelated files; both changed files passed.
